title: Beyond Internal Data: Constructing Complete Datasets for Fairness Testing
findings: The paper does not analyze religion or faith; therefore, there are no findings related to these topics. The key findings relate to the successful generation of synthetic datasets for fairness testing based on race, sex, and age attributes, demonstrating that fairness metrics derived from synthetic data closely match those from real data.
